scope: Combined source must be compared with the base within the native job, never by summing earlier experiment gains. C job CPU is independent. No cross-job absolute timing comparison.

native.profile_scope: No additional source performance claim is inferred from profiles; exact source has passed the current native-selected oracles.

timing_contract.govpx: sum of EncodeInto call durations; input construction, warmup and allocation sampling excluded
timing_contract.libvpx: vpxenc cumulative vpx_codec_encode timer; subprocess/file wall timing reported separately
timing_contract.libvpx_latency: legacy helper latency fields repeat the mean, not measured latency quantiles; not used here
timing_contract.order: three govpx-first and three reference-first runs per case
timing_contract.quality: separate post-timing decode/PSNR/SSIM pass, same inputs and flags
timing_contract.scope: synthetic same-input/controls comparison; differing output/quality/drop work is reported, not assumed equivalent

optimized_c.adaptive_limit: Adaptive VP8 has different Go/C quality and payload work. In this run all separate quality output statistics match their timing samples. Fixed-8 has matched measured quality/payload/counts; no bitstream-identity assertion.

limits: Native three-way comparison used AMD EPYC 7763; optimized-C job used AMD EPYC 9V45. Their absolute times must not be subtracted or compared across jobs.
Current native VP8 beats same-run old ASM on 7763, but the previous 9V45 VP8 +13.026% ASM gap has not yet been remeasured for Stats. C evidence on 9V45 does not close that native comparison.
Quant counts 1/2 regress 3.308%/2.342% against base, every paired sample slower; retained without discarding.
All 81 kernel fixtures are allocation-free. Public VP9 has existing allocations as shown in the complete per-sample arrays; no new C allocation assumption is made.

Fixed-8 C case has matched measured quality/payload/counts; adaptive VP8 and VP9 have differing output/quality work. Quality-pass output statistics match every timed output in this run, but timed bitstream identity is not asserted.
